entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I'd like to start a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number please?
Sure, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is VF789-012.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. Before we proceed, could I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It's a preference thing. It works fine, but it's just not the right fit for my workout routine. I was hoping there's some flexibility in the return window.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up our current policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've checked your purchase date and our policy. It looks like you are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, really? That's great! I was prepared to discuss options, but 90 days is very generous.

Absolutely. Since it was delivered 22 days ago, we can process that return for a full refund right away. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. Thank you, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. I appreciate your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
